newsitem.title: USA: Bell & Howell names Roemer president, CEO.
newsitem.headline: Bell & Howell names Roemer president, CEO.

text.p: Bell & Howell Co said Friday it elected president James Roemer to the additional position of chief executive officer.
It said Roemer, who had held the title of president and chief operating officer, assumes the CEO role previously held by William White, who will remain as chairman of the board.

Roemer, who served as president and COO since February 1995, previously was president and chief executive officer of a Bell & Howell subsidiary in Ann Arbor, Mich. that collects published works and organizes them by subject before converting them to electronic or print format.
Bell & Howell provides information access and dissemination.
